sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 9 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Jitendra Singh

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ramesh Sinha,J.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
This petition seeks issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to
investigate the matter properly in pursuance of the F.I.R. dated 02.08.2022 registered as F.I.R. No.
392 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304-B, 201 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
Police Station Khutar, District Shahjahanpur by taking action against the accused
person/respondents nos. 4 to 10 or transfer the investigation to any other police station of District
Shahjahanpur.
Heard Shri Jitendra Singh, learned Counsel for the petitioner and Shri J.K. Upadhyaya, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the material brought on record.

It transpires that earlier the petitioner had filed Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 15552 of 2022 :
Rajesh Singh Vs. State of U.P. and 9 others, seeking a writ of mandamus directing the respondents Rajesh Singh vs State Of U.P. And 9 Others on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100244365/
1 to ensure fair, impartial and proper investigation of the F.I.R. dated 02.08.2022, registered as F.I.R.
No. 392 of 2022, under Sections 498-A, 304-B, 201 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Khutar, District Shahjahanpur.

sentences.text: A Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, vide order dated 19.10.2022, disposed of the aforesaid writ petition, directing the police authorities to conclude the investigation of the said case fairly, impartially and expeditiously.

Submission of the learned Counsel for the peitioner is that as the investigation of the impugned F.I.R. has not been concluded till date nor the accused persons have been arrested till date, hence the instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, particularly the fact that the relief claimed by the petitioner in the instant writ petition is identical to the relief claimed in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 15552 of 2022, which has already been disposed of by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court by means of the order dated 19.10.2022, directing police auhorities to conclude the investigation of the said case fairly, impartially and expeditiously, we are of the considered view that in view of Chapter XXII Rule 7 of the Allahabad High Court Rules, 1952, no second writ petition for the same cause of action is maintainable and as such, as the instant writ petition is the second writ petition for the same cause of action, hence the instant writ petition is not maintainable.
The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed as not maintainable.
